mapper.select: WITH activities AS ( SELECT 'EXAM' AS kind, e.id, e.title, e.start_time, e.end_time, CASE WHEN e.end_time <= #{now} THEN 'ENDED' WHEN e.start_time <= #{now} THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN e.start_time < #{upcomingEnd} AND (e.end_time IS NULL OR e.end_time > e.start_time) THEN 'UPCOMING' END AS bucket FROM exam e WHERE e.status = 1 AND e.session_status != 'CANCELLED' AND (e.end_time IS NULL OR e.end_time >= #{recentStart}) AND e.created_by = #{ownerId} UNION ALL SELECT 'PRACTICE', p.id, p.title, p.start_time, p.end_time, CASE WHEN p.end_time <= #{now} THEN 'ENDED' WHEN p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.start_time <= #{now} THEN 'ACTIVE' END FROM lesson_practice p WHERE p.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ENDED') AND (p.end_time IS NULL OR p.end_time >= #{recentStart}) AND p.teacher_id = #{ownerId} ), ranked AS ( SELECT activities.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket) AS bucket_size, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY bucket ORDER BY CASE WHEN bucket = 'ACTIVE' AND end_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN bucket = 'ACTIVE' THEN end_time END, CASE WHEN bucket = 'UPCOMING' THEN start_time END, CASE WHEN bucket = 'ENDED' THEN end_time END DESC, kind, id ) AS row_num FROM activities WHERE bucket IS NOT NULL ) SELECT bucket, kind, id, title, start_time, end_time, bucket_size, CASE WHEN kind = 'PRACTICE' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_practice_member m WHERE m.practice_id = ranked.id) END AS member_count FROM ranked WHERE row_num <= 5 ORDER BY bucket, row_num
